_说明: viewer3d.html?model=dairy 的清单。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米；Blender (x, y, z) → (x, z, -y)）。groups 按网格名分角色：roof / walls_ext / interior / floors[]（floor_N）/ props_*（热点）/ site_*。hotspots[].mesh = 点击拾取与高亮的网格；focus / radius 可选（缺省取网格包围盒）；view = 飞过去时相机相对目标的方向（缺省沿当前方位角、俯角 50°）。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 坑两侧各 8 个 35° 斜向牛位，站台高出坑底约 0.95 m。
desc.en: Eight 35° stalls on each side of the pit; platform about 0.95 m above the pit floor.

desc.zh: 四个奶杯接集乳器，不用时挂在牛位下方的挂钩上。
desc.en: Four teat cups on a claw; hung on hooks under each stall when idle.

desc.zh: 不锈钢奶管沿坑壁敷设，略低于站台面，奶靠重力流向集乳罐。
desc.en: Stainless milk line along the pit wall, just below the platform, draining to the receiver.

name.zh: 集乳罐 / 卫生隔离罐

desc.zh: 收集奶管来的奶再泵往奶罐；隔离罐防止液体进入真空系统。
desc.en: Collects milk before it is pumped to the tank; the trap keeps liquid out of the vacuum line.

desc.zh: 6000 L 卧式冷却罐，带搅拌器、控制面板和制冷机组。
desc.en: 6,000 L horizontal cooling tank with agitator, control panel and condensing unit.

desc.zh: 为挤奶和脉动提供稳定负压，附真空罐、仪表和管路。
desc.en: Provides steady vacuum for milking and pulsation, with receiver tank, gauge and piping.

desc.zh: 挤奶后把奶杯插在喷头上，就地循环清洗整条管路。
desc.en: After milking the cups sit on jetters so the whole system is washed in place.

desc.zh: 木桩每 10 m 一根，绝缘子挂上带下线，转角用斜撑加固。
desc.en: Timber posts every 10 m carrying tape and polywire on insulators; braced corners.

desc.zh: 挂在牛舍外墙上，输出脉冲电压，接地桩并排打入土里。
desc.en: Wall-mounted pulse unit outside the shed, with a row of earth rods.

desc.zh: 两条带弹簧把手的绝缘带，挂上即通电、摘下即开门。
desc.en: Two insulated tapes with spring handles: hook on to close, unhook to open.
